name: Godwin's Peak, Paluma
description:
Godwins Peak
Sunday, September 22, 2024
Led by Cherry Judge

Rated - Level 4 . Moderatly difficult. Preferably experienced bushwalkers.
Duration - Approximately 16 km. 7-10 hours.

At an elevation of 783 meters, Godwin's Peak stands out as one of the most rewarding summits to hike within the Paluma Range National Park. From the summit, hikers are treated to a breathtaking 360-degree panoramic view encompassing Mt. Halifax, Townsville, and the coastline.
 This is however a really strenuous walk and the uphill is very steep and slow going. The bush track is rough and uneven underfoot.
Highlights include: Twin and Pick Falls and the Views from the summit.

RSVP: TBWC Members- Free. Visitors/Guests- 5$ ( All welcome, you can become a member after 3 walks

The views from Godwin’s Peak

name: Bluegum Ck
description:
***𝐓𝐇𝐈𝐒 𝐖𝐀𝐋𝐊 𝐈𝐒 𝐀𝐓 𝐂𝐀𝐏𝐀𝐂𝐈𝐓𝐘***

Where -  The Blue Gum Circuit 
Led by - Cherry Judge

Rated- 3. For the moderate level bushwalker. Due to the elevation change a moderate level of fitness is encouraged ie you should be doing regular exercise that makes you puff.

Terrain type - On Track hike. Creek crossings. The track ascends  and descends steeply  - about 400 m elevation (approx 2 Castle Hills). 
Duration ( approx) of walking per day - about 5 hours. Anticipate being back in Paluma village by 2-3 pm

Distance covered ~ 11 kms

Meeting place - will be emailed to those that have RSVPd

About the walk:
The Blue Gum Creek is on the south side of Paluma Village and is a day walk that takes you on a loop across Blue gum Creek, Star Valley, past Triple Falls and Old Wolfram mines. The Blue Gum Creek hikeis mostly on bush tracks in the forest.There is some creek rock hopping at the bottom of the valley.
We will be stopping at Triple Falls for a quick break before we head down to Blue gum valley and check out the lagoon on Bluegum creek. 
Lunch will be at the Miner Creek Falls. 
You will get to see some of the old tin mining era relics in this area, especially around Miners creek and falls. 
For detailed info - check out Wanderstories: https://bit.ly/47qVcLA

What to bring on the walk - https://bit.ly/wtbdayhike

Puzzle Creek
Sunday, September 22, 2024
Led by Ian Wallace 

Rated - Level 4 -5 depending on the route plan.
Moderatly difficult.
Duration - Approximately a 7-8 hour day.

Nestled within the landscape, Puzzle Creek offers a delightful blend of natural features as it joins Running River. This small waterway boasts intimate rocky gorges, sparkling cascades, and inviting sandy beaches. This walk starts within private property - requiring advance permission from the landowner
